title: Concept: KMS key ARN in a response
description: A KMS key ARN with its alias in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The ARN names the key that protects a data class, so an attacker learns which key to target and confirms the key lives in a different account or region from the data.
applicability: Deployments that render a KMS key ARN with its alias into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The ARN names the key that protects a data class, so an attacker learns which key to target and confirms the key lives in a different account or region from the data.
